propositions: Guide markdown files are read from config.repo_root()/docs/ which resolves to consuming project's git toplevel, causing missing-file errors when rebar is installed as a library and run against a project without a docs/ directory
Author guides and criteria guide content must be packaged as runtime data inside the rebar distribution and accessed via importlib.resources to work from any installation
explain_guide() must drop the repo_root_path parameter and resolve guide files from the in-package _guides/ directory instead of project docs/
explain_criterion() must render criterion sections directly from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() rather than reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md from the file system
Existing documentation links and references must remain functional by leaving thin pointer files in docs/ that redirect to the packaged canonical sources
Both prose guides must be verified as packaged resources in the wheel distribution and accessible via CLI, library, and MCP surfaces without dependency on repo root configuration
